blueprint.name: BNK on a NEW IBM ROKS cluster (created end to end)
blueprint.description: Provision a NEW IBM ROKS cluster with its own VPC and Transit Gateway, then install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes onto it. The cluster's workers have Internet egress, so images come from F5's registry and licensing goes direct — no private mirror or License Proxy required. Registers the cluster with BNK Forge as it is created, so you can watch BNK install onto it. The cwc-guard module is deliberately absent: F5's f5-spk-cwc Multi-Attach deadlock only arises on a cluster that has already run BNK, which a freshly created cluster never has.

outcomes: An existing ROKS cluster adopted into the workspace (cluster-outputs.json)
The cluster VPC attached to your existing Transit Gateway
BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes 2.3 installed and reporting status

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. Region and resource group inherit from it.
An orchestration COS bucket holding the FAR auth tarball and the subscription JWT. Blank COS fields fall back to bnk-supply-chain / bnk-artifacts / f5-far-auth-key.tgz / subscription.jwt.

input_summary.label: What it changes
input_summary.value: Only the BNK layer — cert-manager, FLO, the CNEInstance and the License CR. The cluster, its VPC and its worker pool are left exactly as found.

input_summary.label: Teardown
input_summary.value: Destroy runs `bnk down --auto` then `tgw disconnect --auto`. It never runs `cluster down`, so an adopted cluster survives. A Transit Gateway attachment that pre-existed is left alone — roksbnkctl records it without managing it.

optional.name: bnkforge_url
optional.label: BNK Forge URL
optional.description: Register the adopted cluster with a BNK Forge instance so it appears on the Kubernetes page (e.g. https://forge.example.com). Blank = skip registration. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: bnkforge_username
optional.label: BNK Forge username
optional.description: Login for that Forge. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: bnkforge_password
optional.label: BNK Forge password
optional.description: Password for that login. Reaches the step as an environment variable only, never on the command line. Leave blank to use roksbnkctl's default.

optional.name: bnkforge_project
optional.label: BNK Forge project
optional.description: BNK Forge project to register the cluster into. Filled automatically with THIS project's name, so the cluster appears on the Kubernetes page of the project you deployed and its scans can be watched as BNK installs.

optional.name: bnkforge_insecure
optional.label: Skip Forge TLS verification
optional.description: Set true only for a Forge with a self-signed certificate. Defaults to false — verification stays on unless you opt out.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Resolved from the project's credential template when the project is created. Not entered by hand.

optional.name: cluster_vpc_cidr
optional.label: Cluster VPC address block
optional.description: Address block for the new cluster's VPC (/18 or larger). Optional when this cluster creates its own Transit Gateway — nothing to overlap. REQUIRED when you adopt an existing gateway: IBM Cloud's default gives every VPC in a region the same prefixes, so a second VPC on that gateway would collide and the gateway would blackhole one of them. Pick a block no other attached VPC uses.

optional.name: existing_transit_gateway
optional.label: Existing Transit Gateway (name or id)
optional.description: Adopt a Transit Gateway you already have instead of creating one. Blank creates a gateway for this cluster. Adopt one when the cluster must reach resources already on it, or to stay inside the account's gateway quota. When you adopt, set the cluster VPC address block too — every VPC on a gateway needs a distinct block.

optional.name: cluster_vpc_id
optional.label: Existing cluster VPC (id)
optional.description: Place the new cluster in a VPC you already have, instead of creating one (roksbnkctl v1.43.0+). Blank creates the VPC, which is the default. Use this where address space is allocated centrally. Leave 'Existing cluster subnets' blank to have roksbnkctl create the three zone subnets inside the adopted VPC.

optional.name: existing_subnet_ids
optional.label: Existing cluster subnets (ids, comma-separated)
optional.description: Adopt pre-created subnets instead of letting roksbnkctl cut them inside the VPC (roksbnkctl v1.44.0+). Comma-separated subnet ids in ZONE ORDER, e.g. 0717-a,0717-b,0717-c. Requires 'Existing cluster VPC (id)' — roksbnkctl refuses a subnet adopted independently of the VPC that contains it. Blank creates the subnets, which is the default.

optional.name: bnkforge_ca_b64
optional.label: BNK Forge CA (base64 PEM)
optional.description: Base64 PEM of the CA that issued the Forge server's certificate, pinning the registration call. Supply this INSTEAD of 'Skip Forge TLS verification': roksbnkctl v1.50.0 warns on every unverified Forge request, and a pin answers that warning rather than silencing it. Blank when the certificate is publicly trusted.

optional.name: cluster_http_allowed_cidrs
optional.label: CIDRs allowed to reach the cluster
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs permitted inbound to the cluster's security group. Blank keeps the tool default, which before roksbnkctl v1.50.0 was hard-coded 0.0.0.0/0 — set your operator and client ranges rather than leaving a cluster open to the Internet.

optional.name: cluster_network_mode
optional.label: Cluster network mode
optional.description: How the worker nodes are attached. Blank = single-nic, which is every cluster built so far. multi-nic needs BNK 2.4+; CREATE-time only and enforced.

optional.name: trusted_profile_sa
optional.label: Trusted profile sa
optional.description: The IBM Cloud Trusted Profile the CNE controller assumes to manage its own VPC. Blank derives the account FLO actually creates — leave it blank unless you can also make FLO name that account differently.

optional.name: trusted_profile_roles
optional.label: Trusted profile roles
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TRUSTED_PROFILE_ROLES. Blank applies the terraform default ["Viewer", "Editor"] (tfvar trusted_profile_roles).

optional.name: vlan_prefixlen
optional.label: Vlan prefixlen (2.3)
optional.description: [BNK 2.3 only] TMM self-IP masks. INDEPENDENT of the VLAN CIDRs and never derived from them: a mask that deliberately disagrees with its subnet, plus static routes, is how a specific traffic pattern is forced. The per-VLAN pair overrides the shared value; blank inherits.

optional.name: vlan_prefixlen_external
optional.label: Vlan prefixlen external (2.3)
optional.description: [BNK 2.3 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_VLAN_PREFIXLEN_EXTERNAL. Blank applies the terraform default 0 (tfvar cneinstance_vlan_prefixlen_external).

optional.name: vlan_prefixlen_internal
optional.label: Vlan prefixlen internal (2.3)
optional.description: [BNK 2.3 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_VLAN_PREFIXLEN_INTERNAL. Blank applies the terraform default 0 (tfvar cneinstance_vlan_prefixlen_internal).

optional.name: flo_namespace
optional.label: Flo namespace
optional.description: Default f5-bnk and f5-utils. Set BOTH to the same value to install into ONE namespace instead of two — verified working against BNK 2.3. Fewer RBAC surfaces, one NetworkPolicy target, one thing to grant a team. These are an allowlist entry as much as a setting: bnk-env is built from the keys declared in THIS file, so a variable missing here never reaches a workflow no matter what you export.

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.label: Flo utils namespace
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_FLO_UTILS_NAMESPACE. Blank applies the terraform default "f5-utils" (tfvar flo_utils_namespace).

optional.name: cneinstance_size
optional.label: Cneinstance size
optional.description: Deployment size for the CNEInstance (Tiny / Small / Medium / …). Blank uses the terraform default. The legal set is a property of the BNK manifest rather than of this tool, so a bad value is rejected by the operator on the cluster rather than here — deliberately, since hardcoding a list would go stale the first time F5 adds a size.

optional.name: gateway_api_mtls
optional.label: Gateway api mtls (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] true installs the Gateway API 1.5.0 standard bundle BNK 2.4 needs for mTLS. Doing so requires deleting the OpenShift ingress-operator's Gateway API ValidatingAdmissionPolicy and its binding, which the platform recreates — the race roksbnkctl's admission sweep exists to win. Blank/false is right for a base install: 2.4's crd-installer logs a graceful skip and leaves the cluster on the bundle OpenShift ships. Ignored on 2.3, where the sweep always runs because the crd-installer IS blocked without it.

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.label: Tmm replicas (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] All 2.4-only. Left empty, terraform applies F5's reference value, so an empty value here is "use the reference" rather than "unset". TMM placement is what REPLACED the node-labeler on 2.4: the labeler was removed as unnecessary and this is the mechanism that took over. The topology keys are the IBM ROKS node labels, surfaced rather than hard-coded.

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.label: Watch namespaces (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_WATCH_NAMESPACES. Blank applies the terraform default ["All"] (tfvar cneinstance_watch_namespaces).

optional.name: tmm_anti_affinity
optional.label: Tmm anti affinity (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ANTI_AFFINITY. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_anti_affinity).

optional.name: tmm_anti_affinity_topology_key
optional.label: Tmm anti affinity topology key (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ANTI_AFFINITY_TOPOLOGY_KEY. Blank applies the terraform default "kubernetes.io/hostname" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_anti_affinity_topology_key).

optional.name: tmm_zone_spread
optional.label: Tmm zone spread (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_SPREAD. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_spread).

optional.name: tmm_zone_topology_key
optional.label: Tmm zone topology key (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_TOPOLOGY_KEY. Blank applies the terraform default "topology.kubernetes.io/zone" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_topology_key).

optional.name: tmm_zone_max_skew
optional.label: Tmm zone max skew (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_MAX_SKEW. Blank applies the terraform default 1 (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_max_skew).

optional.name: tmm_zone_when_unsatisfiable
optional.label: Tmm zone when unsatisfiable (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ZONE_WHEN_UNSATISFIABLE. Blank applies the terraform default "DoNotSchedule" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_zone_when_unsatisfiable).

optional.name: tmm_pod_label
optional.label: Tmm pod label (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_POD_LABEL. Blank applies the terraform default "f5-tmm" (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_pod_label).

optional.name: tmm_rolling_update
optional.label: Tmm rolling update (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_TMM_ROLLING_UPDATE. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_tmm_rolling_update).

optional.name: external_bigip
optional.label: External bigip (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_EXTERNAL_BIGIP. Blank applies the terraform default false (tfvar cneinstance_external_bigip).

optional.name: external_bigip_login_secret
optional.label: External bigip login secret (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_EXTERNAL_BIGIP_LOGIN_SECRET. Blank applies the terraform default "f5-bigip-ctlr-login" (tfvar cneinstance_external_bigip_login_secret).

optional.name: cluster_identifier
optional.label: Cluster identifier (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_CLUSTER_IDENTIFIER. Blank applies the terraform default "" (empty) (tfvar cneinstance_cluster_identifier).

optional.name: gateway_api_version
optional.label: Gateway api version (2.4)
optional.description: [BNK 2.4 only] roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_GATEWAY_API_VERSION. Blank applies the terraform default "1.5.0" (tfvar cneinstance_gateway_api_version).

optional.name: demo_mode
optional.label: Demo mode
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_DEMO_MODE. Blank applies the terraform default "" (empty) (tfvar cneinstance_demo_mode).

optional.name: whole_cluster
optional.label: Whole cluster
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_WHOLE_CLUSTER. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar cneinstance_whole_cluster).

optional.name: cert_manager_create
optional.label: Cert manager create
optional.description: Adopt what the cluster already has, rather than creating it. An adopted customer cluster very often already runs cert-manager; without this, bnk up fails with "namespaces cert-manager already exists".

optional.name: registry_cos_create
optional.label: Registry cos create
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_REGISTRY_COS_CREATE. Blank applies the terraform default true (tfvar create_roks_registry_cos_instance).

optional.name: cluster_jumphosts_create
optional.label: Cluster jumphosts create
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_CLUSTER_JUMPHOSTS_CREATE. Blank applies the terraform default false (tfvar testing_create_cluster_jumphosts).

optional.name: hugepages
optional.label: Hugepages
optional.description: Allocate hugepages on the worker pool. OFF by default: enabling it sets a bootloader kernel argument, so the Machine Config Operator DRAINS AND REBOOTS every matching worker. deploymentSize Tiny needs none; Small wants 4Gi.

optional.name: hugepages_size
optional.label: Hugepages size
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_HUGEPAGES_SIZE. Blank applies the terraform default "2M" (tfvar cneinstance_hugepages_size).

optional.name: hugepages_count
optional.label: Hugepages count
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_HUGEPAGES_COUNT. Blank applies the terraform default 2048 (tfvar cneinstance_hugepages_count).

optional.name: gateway_class_name
optional.label: Gateway class name
optional.description: GatewayClass is CLUSTER-scoped, so two BNK installs sharing a cluster cannot share the name. Blank → "gateway-class", which is right for one install per cluster and wrong for a matrix that stands two up side by side.

optional.name: gateway_controller_name
optional.label: Gateway controller name
optional.description: The string the CNE controller matches ITSELF against. LEAVE THIS BLANK: blank derives "f5.com/<flo_namespace>-f5-cne-controller", which is what a controller this deployment installed calls itself, and it follows a changed ROKSBNKCTL_FLO_NAMESPACE automatically. Set it only to aim the GatewayClass at a controller deployed by something else. A wrong value fails SILENTLY — the apply succeeds, the GatewayClass is never Accepted, and no traffic flows.

optional.name: gateway_route_examples
optional.label: Gateway route examples
optional.description: Extra route kinds to create WORKING examples of, alongside the HTTPRoute the gateway phase always creates. Comma-separated. Blank leaves an existing deployment byte-identical. On BNK 2.3 the only valid values are GRPCRoute and L4Route, and that is not arbitrary: 2.3 pins Gateway API 1.4.1 STANDARD, which contains no TCPRoute, TLSRoute or UDPRoute at all. BNK provides L4Route (gateway.k8s.f5net.com/v1) for TCP instead. Anything else is refused at plan time rather than creating an object no controller will ever claim. Setting L4Route also adds a TCP listener to the Gateway, because an L4Route cannot attach to an HTTP listener.

optional.name: gateway_l4_listener_port
optional.label: Gateway l4 listener port
optional.description: Port for that TCP listener. Blank → 8080.

optional.name: worker_flavor
optional.label: Worker node profile
optional.description: Exact IBM Cloud worker profile, e.g. cx3d.8x20. Blank auto-selects, and the auto-select only ever considers the bx2 family — F5's approved reference cluster runs cx3d.8x20, which auto-select cannot produce at any minimum. Set it explicitly to reproduce the reference.

optional.name: client_region
optional.label: Client region
optional.description: The region the testing client (TGW jumphost + client VPC) is installed in. Maps to config.yaml resources.client_region.

optional.name: cluster_jumphosts_existing
optional.label: Cluster jumphosts existing
optional.description: The name or ID of the resource to adopt when Create is false. Maps to config.yaml resources.cluster_jumphosts.existing.

optional.name: cluster_vpc_create
optional.label: Cluster vpc create
optional.description: -> resources.bnk.create, resources.cert_manager.create, resources.client_vpc.create, resources.cluster_jumphosts.create, resources.cluster_vpc.create, resources.registry_cos.create, resources.tgw_jumphost.create, resources.transit_gateway.create

optional.name: cluster_vpc_default_sg_inbound_cidrs
optional.label: Cluster vpc default sg inbound cidrs
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_CLUSTER_VPC_DEFAULT_SG_INBOUND_CIDRS. Maps to config.yaml resources.cluster_vpc_default_sg_inbound_cidrs[0].

optional.name: min_worker_memory_gb
optional.label: Min worker memory gb
optional.description: The memory floor for the same auto-select. Maps to config.yaml cluster.min_worker_memory_gb.

optional.name: min_worker_vcpu_count
optional.label: Min worker vcpu count
optional.description: The vCPU floor for the worker-flavor auto-select: the cluster module picks the smallest bx2 profile meeting this and MinWorkerMemoryGB. Maps to config.yaml cluster.min_worker_vcpu_count.

optional.name: registry_cos_existing
optional.label: Registry cos existing
optional.description: The name or ID of the resource to adopt when Create is false. Maps to config.yaml resources.registry_cos.existing.

optional.name: transit_gateway_create
optional.label: Transit gateway create
optional.description: -> resources.bnk.create, resources.cert_manager.create, resources.client_vpc.create, resources.cluster_jumphosts.create, resources.cluster_vpc.create, resources.registry_cos.create, resources.tgw_jumphost.create, resources.transit_gateway.create

optional.name: bnk_existing
optional.label: Bnk existing
optional.description: The name or ID of the resource to adopt when Create is false. Maps to config.yaml resources.bnk.existing.

optional.name: cert_manager_existing
optional.label: Cert manager existing
optional.description: The name or ID of the resource to adopt when Create is false. Maps to config.yaml resources.cert_manager.existing.

optional.name: cert_manager_namespace
optional.label: Cert manager namespace
optional.description: Namespace cert-manager installs into (rendered as cert_manager_namespace). Maps to config.yaml bnk.cert_manager.namespace.

optional.name: cert_manager_version
optional.label: Cert manager version
optional.description: Version pins the cert-manager Helm chart (rendered as cert_manager_version). Maps to config.yaml bnk.cert_manager.version.

optional.name: far_auth_local_file
optional.label: Far auth local file
optional.description: FarAuthLocalFile / SubscriptionJWTLocalFile point at LOCAL files instead of COS objects. Maps to config.yaml bnk.far_auth_local_file.

optional.name: far_repo_url
optional.label: Far repo url
optional.description: The F5 Artifact Repository charts are pulled from. Maps to config.yaml bnk.far_repo_url.

optional.name: gateway_app_namespace
optional.label: Gateway app namespace
optional.description: The namespace the example application and its Gateway resources are created in. Maps to config.yaml gateway.app_namespace.

optional.name: gateway_backend_port
optional.label: Gateway backend port
optional.description: The port on that Service. Maps to config.yaml gateway.backend_port.

optional.name: gateway_backend_service
optional.label: Gateway backend service
optional.description: The Kubernetes Service the example HTTPRoute forwards to. Maps to config.yaml gateway.backend_service.

optional.label: Gateway client subnet local
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_GATEWAY_CLIENT_SUBNET_LOCAL. Maps to config.yaml gateway.client_subnet_local[0].

optional.name: gateway_client_subnet_remote
optional.label: Gateway client subnet remote
optional.description: roksbnkctl setting ROKSBNKCTL_GATEWAY_CLIENT_SUBNET_REMOTE. Maps to config.yaml gateway.client_subnet_remote[0].

optional.name: gateway_egress_mode
optional.label: Gateway egress mode
optional.description: EgressMode selects how return traffic is source-addressed: "snatpool", "automap", or "both". Maps to config.yaml gateway.egress_mode.

optional.name: gateway_vxlan_port
optional.label: Gateway vxlan port
optional.description: The UDP port for the VXLAN overlay between TMM and the nodes. Maps to config.yaml gateway.vxlan_port.

optional.name: gslb_datacenter_name
optional.label: Gslb datacenter name
optional.description: GSLBDatacenterName sets the optional CNEInstance GSLB datacenter name (rendered as cneinstance_gslb_datacenter_name). Maps to config.yaml bnk.gslb_datacenter_name.

optional.name: hugepages_node_role
optional.label: Hugepages node role
optional.description: The machineconfiguration.openshift.io/role the profile applies to. Maps to config.yaml bnk.hugepages.node_role.

optional.name: hugepages_profile_name
optional.label: Hugepages profile name
optional.description: ProfileName names the Tuned profile and CR. Maps to config.yaml bnk.hugepages.profile_name.

optional.name: storage_class_name
optional.label: Storage class name
optional.description: The StorageClass the CNEInstance's persistent volumes use, TMM's included. Maps to config.yaml bnk.storage_class_name.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_local_file
optional.label: Subscription jwt local file
optional.description: The F5 subscription JWT as a LOCAL file, the companion to FarAuthLocalFile above. Maps to config.yaml bnk.subscription_jwt_local_file.

optional.name: tcp_settings_name
optional.label: Tcp settings name
optional.description: The F5BigTcpSetting to write. Maps to config.yaml bnk.tcp_settings_name.

optional.name: tmm_k8s_routes
optional.label: Tmm k8s routes
optional.description: The Kubernetes pod CIDR TMM installs a route toward (advanced.tmm.env TMM_K8S_ROUTES), so TMM can reach backend pods on the internal data path. Maps to config.yaml bnk.network.tmm_k8s_routes.

modules.name: roksbnkctl Cluster Create
modules.description: Create the VPC, ROKS cluster and Transit Gateway, then register the cluster with BNK Forge — registration runs first, so it is visible and monitorable while BNK installs.

modules.name: roksbnkctl BNK Install
modules.description: init -> cluster register -> bnk up -> bnk status, against an existing cluster.
